evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/news_articles.rs:607-770 — publish_article, archive_article, restore_article, pin_article extract `_user: AuthUser` but never check `is_manager()`/authorship, unlike create_article (line 446) and update_article (line 542) which explicitly gate on `is_manager || is_author`.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/news_articles.rs:710-728 — delete_article permanently deletes an article with no role/author check at all; any authenticated org member can destroy any article in their tenant.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/news_articles.rs:794-851 — add_media/delete_media have no authorization check; any authenticated org member can attach or remove media on any article, bypassing the manager-only authoring model documented in the handler comments for create_article.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/news_articles.rs:958-987 — create_comment never reads article.comments_enabled before inserting a comment, so an article with comments disabled (CreateArticleRequest.comments_enabled=false / UpdateArticleRequest) can still be commented on.
backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/news_articles.rs:858-891 — toggle_reaction never reads article.reactions_enabled, so reactions can be added even when the author/manager disabled them.

backend/crates/db/src/models/news_article.rs:50-51,352-354 — comments_enabled/reactions_enabled are persisted columns but grep across news_articles.rs/news_article.rs repo shows no handler-side check gating create_comment or toggle_reaction on these flags.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/admin/memberships.rs:365 — generate_token() calls `rand::TryRng::try_fill_bytes(...).expect("OS rng failed")`; this helper is called directly from the `invite` handler (line 194) on the request path, so an OS RNG failure panics the handler instead of returning a 500.
